# Bundled MCP runtime notices

Generated from exact development pins and package-lock.json. The runtime bundle is shipped so released MCP and CLI commands need no npm installation. Source: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk

The MCP SDK packages contain their complete Apache-2.0/MIT transition notice. Their original LICENSE files are retained verbatim below. Our surrounding code remains MIT. No upstream REA code is included.
